{{Top}}
A '''science officer''' was a title held by scientific officers in some armed forces.

In the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], they were generally part of the command team assigned to [[IM-455 modular garrison]]s during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

[[Gann Sakoal]] and [[Garboza]] served as science officers in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Quiet Kill|Balmorra}}</ref>

[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Karenna Dunnels|Dunnels]] was a science officer in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].<ref name="SWG:HLDwitmNB">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=class|Legacy|Help Lt. Dunnels with ingredients to make Neural Boosters|Naboo}}</ref>
